meta.method: Measured on the rendered board: getBoundingClientRect of every visible element, in the default state and with each drawer, the periscope, the helm and the orders station opened in turn. Elements hidden by an ancestor are skipped. Records carry the state in which they first appear; "default" is the board as it loads.

matching.exact: same paint as the sprite (background, radius, shadow)
matching.background: same background and radius at a different size (9-sliced or standardised sprites)
matching.layers: a drawer body whose background is the panel_drawer stack plus the drawer_rib strip
matching.sliver beside knob: pointer or detent tick found by size beside a knob

meta.rotation: degrees clockwise, about the element centre; rects are the rotated bounding box
